title: Seizure Sources Can Be Imaged from Scalp EEG by Means of Biophysically Constrained Deep Neural Networks
summary: In 33 patients, source maps were evaluated against iEEG-defined seizure-onset zones and successful resection; reported source localization was close to the clinically referenced focus. Clinical-reference comparison in 33 patients; retrospective validation, no prospective utility study. Exact DOI/title and result-level epilepsy comparisons in active/archive snapshots found no match.
